mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 6 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 3 months and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy combined with slow economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with slow growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%, and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000, and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over the past 6 months indicates strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases over 6 months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 1% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 1%, and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
